'''Undead Grasp''' is a [[Grasp_spells|Grasp Spell]] within the [[Arceuus spellbook]] that requires level 79 [[Magic]] and the completion of [[A Kingdom Divided]] to be cast. This spell has a base max hit of 24, and has a 50% chance to stop the target from moving for four [[ticks]] (2.4 seconds); streak marks mid-animation indicate a successful bind on the target. The chance to bind an opponent is only rolled upon a [[successful hit]], which means that a bind will not be rolled if the spell fails the accuracy roll.

Undead Grasp has a 100% chance to bind a target if the [[Mark of Darkness]] spell is active, though the bind duration remains the same. However, if the target is under the effects of the [[Ward of Arceuus]] spell, they will only be bound in place for one [[tick]] (0.6 seconds) if successfully bound by the caster. 

Undead Grasp is relatively rare in that it has a static [[hit delay]] regardless of distance to the target, and is used in some niche speedrunning situations.
